```{R}
source("../get_metabolites.R")  

final_47 <- read.csv("../4-twas/jad/targets_both.csv", header = FALSE)$V1
targets_to_metabolites_all <- get_metabolites(final_47, "lab" )
targets_to_metabolites_all <- lapply(targets_to_metabolites_all, unique)

metabolites <- c("10176710", "no3", "348154", "10394")

metabolite_to_targets <- lapply(metabolites, function(met) {
  names(targets_to_metabolites_all)[
    sapply(targets_to_metabolites_all, function(x) met %in% x)
  ]
})

names(metabolite_to_targets) <- c("10176710", "m5", "348154", "10394")

targets_m5 <- metabolite_to_targets$m5

```
